234: [edit] When the night of Tisha be-Av falls on the first day of the week, when one sees the flame they should say: "Creator of the lights of fire", but one does not make a blessing on the fragrances. On the night after Tisha Be-Av one makes "havdallah" on a cup [of wine] and does not make a blessing, neither on the flame nor on the fragrances.
